# Foundation (1)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **feel-auto**: Picks the platform feel for you: macOS, iOS, Windows or web, from the device, before the first paint. Not for: Apps that always want one feel: install feel-macos, feel-ios or feel-windows instead.
